# OBS Dynamics

> Free, open-source Windows application (GPL-3.0) that switches OBS Studio scenes automatically: it detects which game is running, tells menu from gameplay by matching the screen against reference screenshots, and drives OBS through its WebSocket (v5). Made by Blackoune. Independent project, not affiliated with the OBS Project.

Key facts:
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11. No macOS or Linux version.
- Requires OBS Studio 28 or later (built-in WebSocket server).
- Works from 720p to 4K. Screen checked every 2 s by default (0.5 s minimum).
- A switch needs two matching reads and a lead of at least 0.15 between states.
- Hotkeys: F1 forces "in game", F2 "menu", F3 "idle".
- Overlays as OBS browser sources: key-combo media (image, video, sound, hold mode), anonymous Twitch chat, music "now playing" widget (5 layouts, 8 themes).
- Interface in 39 languages.
- 100% local: no account, no telemetry. Credentials encrypted with Windows DPAPI.
- The executable is built by GitHub Actions only; SHA-256 and build provenance attestation published with each release.
